title: Kyber release 0.29
author: Jean-Baptiste Kempf
quote: Kyber 0.29 make am easy to set up real time control, e dey show tins clear well well, and e don ready for plenty more kain environment.
html:
Kyber 0.29: e reach far pass, picture sharp pass, control strong pass

Kyber 0.29 make am easy to set up real time control, e dey show tins clear well well, and e don ready for plenty more kain environment. Native WebSocket support dey carry Kyber enter company network wey before no dey gree am, 4:4:4 encoding dey keep every small detail for di screen native resolution, and new embedded capture features don open road for Raspberry Pi and edge deployment. E still bring di first foundation wey go help pipo manage plenty Kyber machine togeda at once.

Dis na wetin all dat one mean for real life.

E reach far pass: Kyber dey work now for network wey before dey block am

Wen di network say no

As e dey normally, Kyber dey connect through QUIC, one modern network protocol wey dem build for speed. Na one of di reasons why Kyber dey fast like say e dey for your front. But wahala dey: some company network dey block QUIC, or dem no just dey accept am. For operator wey wan reach machine wey dey behind strict firewall, dat one mean say connection no go happen at all.

Kyber don find anoda road with WebSocket

Kyber 0.29 don add full backup road through WebSocket, one standard wey almost every network dey accept. If dem block QUIC, Kyber go switch go WebSocket and di connection go enter. E go slow small, but you go still dey connected. Your control road go still dey open, no mata wetin IT pipo rule talk.

WebSocket support don dey native for inside Kyber desktop client now. For inside di engine, di browser version and di desktop version dey share di same connection code, so any improvement wey land go reach both of dem at di same time.

Picture sharp pass: every pixel, every colour, for any machine

Why remote screen dey usually look blur

To save bandwidth, most video streaming dey keep colour for lower resolution pass brightness. For film, nobody go notice. But for work screen, everybody go see am: small small spreadsheet cell go hard to read, brand colour go dey shift, thin lines for 3D model go dey rub enter each oda.

Full 4:4:4 colour for your native resolution

Kyber 0.29 dey encode for full 4:4:4 colour, wey mean say every pixel go keep im correct colour. Text go dey clear, interface go dey sharp and colour go dey correct, even for machine wey im graphics hardware no fit encode 4:4:4 by imsef.

Kyber don also stop to dey shrink big screen. Before now, software encoding dey reduce anytin wey wide pass 1920 pixels go Full HD. Dat limit don commot. 4K desktop now dey stream for 4K.

Your Excel go dey readable, anywhere wey e dey run.

More platforms: real time control, even for Raspberry Pi

Kyber server fit capture image now through GStreamer, di main toolkit wey plenty embedded devices dey use for audio and video. Dis release still bring better way to choose hardware, better frame handling and encoding wey no dey take time again, plus fix for one crash wey dey happen for Intel Arc graphics card.

Togeda, all dis changes dey allow us to adjust Kyber well well for Raspberry Pi and oda small devices wey no dey chop power. Dis one mata for robotics, drones and every edge device wey Kyber low latency streaming need to run for small hardware. Special Raspberry Pi package dey come soon for GitLab.

Control strong pass: di foundation to manage plenty Kyber machine at once

Management portal dey come, wey go allow teams see and control every Kyber machine from one place. Kyber 0.29 don lay di foundation.

Heartbeat for every machine

One new agent dey allow every Kyber host send small signal like every 10 seconds to tok say e dey online and e ready. If di signal stop, you go know say di machine no dey available. No need to dey guess, no need to dey check am by hand.

Sessions wey go stay signed in

Connections wey don pass authentication now dey get automatic token exchange and renewal. Token be like temporary digital pass. Kyber dey renew am for background now, so secure sessions go stay open without say users go dey sign in again and again.

One click access with kyber:// links

Kyber don get im own link format now. Click kyber:// link for browser, for email or for dashboard, and di desktop client go open straight for di correct machine.

E don easy to set up for macOS

Kyber server for macOS now dey come as complete package. E simple to install and e simple to share across plenty Mac. Wetin dey come next: one package wey dey work fully, wey dem don sign, wey macOS go trust from day one.

Oda improvements and fixes

  • Audio: di Opus audio codec don move go version 1.6.1.
  • Security: OIDC, di standard wey dey behind single sign-on, now dey support audience validation wey you fit choose to use. Kyber fit check say na for Kyber dem issue login token, no be for anoda app.
  • Certificates: Kyber now dey check secure connections against di list of trusted certificates wey your operating system get.
  • Web client: pointer lock now dey work well for games wey dey hide di cursor.
  • VLC: di Video buffer feature now dey work with VideoToolbox, Apple hardware video decoder.
  • Reliability: e dey comot clean wen no display dey, session dey close quick pass before, fix for GCC 16 build and logs wey no dey make noise like before.

Collect Kyber 0.29

Kyber 0.29 don land now. Everytin wey you need to take start dey here.
